verdict.rationale: The firm documents an Employment practice that advises startups on employment-law compliance, HR policies, and employee handbooks. No evidence shows it prepares offer letters, employment agreements, or employee invention-assignment/confidentiality agreements. The Clerky workflow covers founder vesting and IP details, not employee hiring paperwork, and trade-secret 'information protection programs' are an adjacent service, so neither earns credit here.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm prepares hiring paperwork — offer letters, employment agreements, and invention-assignment/confidentiality agreements — as part of a documented employment practice

citations.quote: Providing regular advice and counseling on employment law compliance for startups and other corporate clients
